subject: Request: Secure SDLC evidence bundle + change custody notes
messages:
From: Eva Turner <eva.turner@novaassess.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: GreenBank Security <security@greenbank.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GreenBank SIG follow-up: SDLC artifacts request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As part of GreenBank's SIG intake we're collecting a compact evidence set for Redwood's secure SDLC. Could you please provide the following by EOD 22 Mar so we can keep the assessor timeline: 

1) Code review proof: recent PR approval export (showing reviewers and timestamps) covering last 90 days
2) CI/CD control evidence: a representative pipeline run showing gating checks (lint/tests/signing) and an associated merge gate approval
3) Secrets management: rotation schedule and an example of an ephemeral credential use-case (logs or ticket)
4) Change management: a short chronology for any non-emergency deploys in Feb–Mar 2027 (who approved, ticket ids, linked commits)

If possible, include a small narrative describing how PR approvals tie to release gates. If some items are hosted on internal drives, a short index file or exported CSV is fine. If any of the items need redaction, let me know what you will redact and why.

Regards,
Eva Turner
Senior Assessor, Nova Assess

--
Attached: none (please attach artifacts inline or provide links)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Eva Turner <eva.turner@novaassess.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenBank SIG follow-up: SDLC artifacts request

Hi Eva — thanks for the clear list. We're on it and will deliver a consolidated bundle by COB 22 Mar. Looping in Karthik (CI/infra) and Jordan (engineering release lead) to pull logs and the PR export.

Quick notes upfront:
- We'll provide an exported CSV of PR approvals (redacts email addresses per policy but keeps reviewer handles + timestamps).
- CI run will include pipeline stage timestamps and the merge-gate approval event id; we will remove internal runner hostnames.
- Secrets rotation matrix is an export of our key rotation schedule; for the ephemeral example we'll include an incident ticket that shows ephemeral token issuance and automated expiry.
- Change chronology will be a single PDF timeline referencing commits and ticket numbers.

If you need raw commit hashes or deeper logs, say the word and we'll share via the secure Drive link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will follow)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenBank SIG follow-up: SDLC artifacts request

Marissa / team — preparing the artifacts listed. Summary of what's attached and what we will redact: 

1) sdlc-pr-approval-export-20270318.csv 
   - Columns: pr_id, repo, author_handle, approver_handle, approval_timestamp, approval_type
   - Redactions: approver email -> replaced with handle; internal-only repos omitted per policy.

2) ci-pipeline-run-20270318.log 
   - Includes: stage start/stop, test summaries, policy gating results, merge gate event id MG-43871
   - Redactions: worker instance ids replaced with internal aliases.

3) secret-rotation-matrix-2027Q1.xlsx 
   - Metadata: rotation cadence, last_rotation_date, owner_handle, rotation_mechanism (kms/ephemeral)
   - Ephemeral example: ticket SEC-2147 shows ephemeral credential minting for third-party integration; includes requestor, issuance time, TTL and automated revocation event.

4) change-control-chronology-202703.pdf 
   - One-page chronology of non-emergency deploys (Feb–Mar 2027) with approver handles and linked commit ids (short SHAs).

Storage: artifacts uploaded to internal Drive folder; public assessor link below. If you need the raw pipeline trace, I can provide a time-limited signed URL.

-Karthik
Engineering Security

Attachments: sdlc-pr-approval-export-20270318.csv, ci-pipeline-run-20270318.log, secret-rotation-matrix-2027Q1.xlsx

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 17:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenBank SIG follow-up: SDLC artifacts request — bundle delivered

Hi Eva / GreenBank team,

Attached is the consolidated evidence bundle for the SDLC requests. Summary of deliverables:

- sdlc-pr-approval-export-20270318.csv (PR approval export, reviewer handles and timestamps)
- ci-pipeline-run-20270318.log (representative pipeline run with merge gate event MG-43871)
- secret-rotation-matrix-2027Q1.xlsx (rotation schedule + ephemeral example SEC-2147)
- change-control-chronology-202703.pdf (chronology for non-emergency deploys Feb–Mar 2027)

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSdlcEvidence (assessor access granted), HubSpot: HS-Record-1204873, JIRA: SEC-9812

Redaction notes: email addresses were replaced with internal handles; host-specific runner names were aliased to avoid operational disclosure. We can provide additional unredacted artifacts under a DPA / secure transfer if required by your audit process.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the package satisfies GreenBank's SIG leaf nodes or if you need specific commit diffs/stack traces. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through the chronology and gating logic.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference
